name: browserless
description: Connect Browserless to Fractal through its MCP server and access the operations exposed to the connected account.

interface.shortDescription: Use Browserless MCP tools from your Fractal workspace.
interface.longDescription: Connect Browserless to your Fractal workspace so your agent can work with cloud browsers for agents using the tools exposed by the service. Available actions depend on the live MCP server and the connected account’s permissions.
defaultPrompt: Give me an overview of my Browserless workspace.
Find anything in Browserless that needs attention and explain why.
Help me review cloud browsers for agents in Browserless.
